children: Calgary, Canada – TheNewswire - September 8, 2026 – Onco-Innovations Limited (CBOE CA: ONCO) (OTCQB: ONNVF) (Frankfurt: W1H, WKN: A3EKSZ) ("Onco" or the "Company”) announces that, on September 8, 2026, it entered into debt settlement agreements, each dated August 31, 2026 (collectively, the “Settlement Agreements”), with certain insiders and consultants of the Company (collectively, the “Creditors”) to settle an aggregate of $481,694 in outstanding indebtedness owed to the Creditors (collectively, the “Debt”). Pursuant to the Settlement Agreements, the Company will issue an aggregate of 860,168 common shares in the authorized share structure of the Company (each, a “Share” and collectively, the “Shares”) to the Creditors at a deemed price of $0.56 per Share in full settlement of the Debt (the “Debt Settlement”).

The issuance of Shares to RHM Management Inc., an entity controlled by David Antony, the Company’s Chief Financial Officer and Corporate Secretary, and to Carnarvon Strategies-Health Industry Solutions Inc., an entity controlled by Thomas O’Shaughnessy, the Company’s Chief Executive Officer, constitutes a related party transaction within the meaning of Multilateral Instrument 61-101 – Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions (“MI 61-101”). The Company is relying on the exemptions from the formal valuation and minority approval requirements set out in sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101 because neither the fair market value of the Shares nor the fair market value of the consideration paid for the Shares exceeded 25% of the Company’s market capitalization.

The Company has not filed a material change report at least 21 days before the anticipated closing date of the Debt Settlement because the terms of the Debt Settlement were not finalized until shortly before closing, and the Company wished to complete the Debt Settlement on an expedited basis for business reasons.
The issuance and listing of Shares pursuant to the Debt Settlement remains subject to final approval from CBOE Canada.

Onco-Innovations is a Canadian-based company dedicated to cancer research and treatment, specializing in oncology. Onco’s mission is to pursue the prevention and treatment of cancer through pioneering research and innovative solutions. The company has secured an exclusive worldwide license to patented technology that targets solid tumours.
